prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality tuition comparison infographic poster for studying in France in 2026-2027. Centerpiece is a three-column table comparing preparatory language, bachelor's, and master's tuition across public, private, and other categories. Background is a white grid-paper academic layout with euro icons and VFE branding. Surrounding elements: title 'HỌC PHÍ DU HỌC PHÁP 2026 - 2027', money bag illustration, specific euro price ranges, footnotes for 2026 data and exchange rate, and red CTA 'ĐĂNG KÝ NGAY'. Technical style: vector-style tuition comparison poster, flat academic infographic lighting, crisp text readability, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
